reason: I'm a do-it-yourself operator; before I wire €9,500 to anyone I'll read the book, watch the blog and try rebuilding the pitch myself first. The problem is real, but a 3-week sprint with no promise it actually unsticks deals isn't where I spend seed money right now.
objection: No hay garantia de resultado: I pay a fixed fee up front and could still walk away with a prettier pitch that doesn't close a single enterprise deal.
would_change_my_mind: Tie the fee to outcomes or show me named case studies of comparable seed/Series A ops-tech founders whose enterprise conversion measurably improved after the sprint.
